description:
Correct two erroneous timeclock entries for agent James Lankford (User 7001) using the Vicidial Admin interface.

Scenario:
1. On **February 24, 2026**, James accidentally clocked out at **09:15:00** instead of working his full shift. Correct the **LOGOUT** time to **17:30:00**.
2. On **February 25, 2026**, James was delayed by IT issues. Correct his **LOGIN** time from **09:30:00** to **09:00:00** (the approved start time).

Steps:
1. Navigate to the **Users** section.
2. Find user **7001** (James Lankford) and go to **User Stats**.
3. Click on **Timeclock Log**.
4. Modify the specific records to match the approved times.
5. Submit the changes.
